supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: moderate lateral extension extending approximately 10-15% of the orbital width beyond the lateral canthus

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast; the muzzle and circumoral area exhibit significantly higher pixel intensity (pale/flesh-toned) relative to the low-intensity (black/dark brown) periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate 2D vertical thickness with a slight structural droop of the lower lip at the midline

other_distinctive_markers: sparse light-colored (white/grey) filiform hairs present on the chin and mandibular border
